note.simple: The message itself, inside the locked box.
note.technical: The application message: a request for the next video segment, or a piece of the response. Shown in HTTP/1.1’s text form; most video today travels as HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 (over QUIC), which carry the same fields in binary frames.

ask.simple: “Please send me the next bit of the cat video!”
ask.technical: A request for the next video segment.

send.simple: “Here’s the next bit of the cat video!”
send.technical: A response: the next video segment.

start.about: The request (method and path) or the response status.

header.name: Header
header.about: One of several header lines; the rest of the headers and the body follow.

note.simple: The message itself, in plain writing: ordinary pages weren’t locked in 1995.
note.technical: The application message in plain HTTP/1.0: a request for the page or its picture, or a piece of the answer.

ask.simple: “Please send me the page with the picture!”

send.technical: A response: a piece of the page.

note.simple: The message itself, in plain writing: video wasn't locked in 2010.
note.technical: The application message in plain HTTP: a request for the video, or a piece of the response.

ask.technical: A request for the video file.

send.simple: “Here’s the next bit of the cat video!”
send.technical: A response: the next piece of the video file.
